title: Missingness-aware denominators for the 2025 Rubisco screen
question: Which finite-library high-rate fractions and form comparisons are identified given low flags and missing rates?
method: Reconcile primary CSVs, notebook and prior ledger. Count corrected rates at fixed thresholds with three denominators. Compute sharp finite-record frequency and median bounds and enumerate attainable signs by form.
result: C08 identifies form II above I at both cutoffs, while II versus III can reverse. The ≥10 majority among numeric records is unresolved across all eligible records. Adding low flags reverses the measured new-versus-prior ordering.
limitations: Selected finite collection includes targeted expansion and earlier measurements.
Bounds on latent rates require a comparable endpoint for each unresolved entry. Expression failure causes are not resolved per record.
Thresholds condition on reported calibrated means. No inference across natural sequence diversity or accounting for kinetic measurement error.
